(The mass so chosen that it is heavy enough to provide noticeable tension but not so heavy that it immediately breaks the weak string.) Determine the position in the circular path where the tension in the string is minimized to understand the safest conditions for whirling the object. Remember, the string is most likely to break at the point of maximum tension, which occurs at the bottom of the path.
